units.title: Fundamentals of Robotics and its classification
topics: 1.1. Definition and Block Diagram of ROBOT
1.2. Classification of Robots: ● Based on location (fixed, mobile) ● Based on Utilization (Industry, service) ● Based on signal transmission medium (wired and wireless)
1.3. Functional Elements of ROBOT: ● Power Supplies ● Sensors ● Electric AC/DC motor ● Servomotor ● Driving mechanism ● Manipulators ● End Effectors ● Locomotion device ● Controllers
1.4. Applications of ROBOT: ● Line follower Robot ● Gesture control Robot ● Humanoid ● Camera Drone ROBOTIC WORKSHOP PRACTICES Course Code: 1314101
uos: 1.a. Understand the block diagram of ROBOT.
1.b. Classify the different types of ROBOTS.
1.c. Identify the functional elements of ROBOT.
1.d. Explain the function of components used in ROBOT.
1.f. Identify the components of the listed application of ROBOT.

units.title: Application of Electrical and Electronic Components in Robotics
topics: 2.1. Concept of Electrical and Electronics ● AC/DC Power Supply
2.2. Electrical Component ● Transformer, fuse, choke ● DC, Servomotor, Stepper motor
2.3. Electronic Component ● Resistor, capacitor, inductor ● Diode, transistor ● LED, LDR, Photodiode, Phototransistor ● Relay and Switches

2.4. PCB, wiring, soldering de-soldering ● PCB layout in Simulation software ● Types of electrical wiring (Batten, capping and casing, cleat, conduit) ● Types of wiring joint (‘T’ joint, western union, married, straight, twisted and Britannia) ● Soldering and de-soldering
uos: 2.a. Perform wiring of different types of transformers, fuse, and choke in power supply.
2.b. Use different types of motor used in ROBOT.
2.c. Use different electronic components to perform various circuits.
2.d. Prepare PCB layout on paper and simulation software.
2.e. Build various circuits on simulation software using electrical and electronic components.
2.f. Build various circuits on PCB using electrical and electronic components.

units.title: Construction of ROBOT
topics: 3.1. Fabrication of mechanical components ● Fitting, Welding, Drilling ● Mechanical Joints used in ROBOTICS (colinear, orthogonal, rotational, twisting, revolving)
3.2. Construction of ROBOT ● Mechanical Structure ● Placement of electrical and electronic components and wiring ● Testing and Troubleshooting
uos: 3.a. Explain the concept of fitting, welding, and drilling to fabricate mechanical components.
3.b. Discuss various components in the robotic application.
3.c. Assemble various mechanical, electrical and electronic components to construct ROBOT.
